note: Single source of truth for the 10-subject main-run roster: 5 hosted/API subjects (Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Grok 4.3, Kimi K2.6) and 5 local/self-hosted subjects (Llama 3.3-70B-Instruct, Gemma 4 31B IT, Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B, GLM-4.7-Flash, Mistral Medium 3.5 128B). The primary estimand remains the within-subject TOOL versus DISABLED contrast; DISABLED means schemas remain model-visible while relevant tool calls are disabled. Hosted/API versus local/self-hosted is a pre-registered descriptive heterogeneity stratum, not a causal serving-context comparison. Sen-Q is the paired local/self-hosted primary-vs-4-bit deployment-path audit on the predeclared 96-prompt subset and covers all five local subjects, including GLM-4.7-Flash and Mistral Medium 3.5 128B. Quantization-audit rows carry serving_precision_role=quantization_audit and are excluded from H1. Chat-path judging uses subject-level family exclusion: default judges are GLM 5.1, Cohere Command A, and Mistral Large 3; a same-family judge is replaced for the entire subject by GPT-5.5 judge, then Claude Opus 4.7 judge if needed. Predicate-graded structured rows do not route to substitute judges. Rejected candidates and route-failure reasons are retained under archived_models.

local_config.precision_primary_note: BF16/FP16 reference served on a self-managed external GPU instance via vLLM. The checkpoint is downloaded from https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct at hf_commit_sha before inference. No M5 MLX fallback is permitted for primary precision because BF16/FP16 weights exceed the 128 GB unified-memory budget. Record served dtype, GPU type, tensor parallelism, context window, per-file Hugging Face LFS SHA-256 metadata, and the post-download local SHA-256 manifest before dispatch.
local_config.precision_sensitivity_note: AWQ INT4 (W4A16) checkpoint served primarily on the same external cloud-GPU substrate as the BF16/FP16 reference (Lambda.ai or Verda.com; H100 / H200 / B200 / B300 / RTX PRO 6000 / A100 80GB; ~35GB resident, fits a single 80GB GPU). decoding._overrides_note: Per-model decoding overrides. All active runner requests use max_tokens=4096 unless a later design-locked provider-specific compatibility test requires removal. `null` value = remove the parameter entirely (do NOT pass it). Kimi K2.6 keeps temperature=1.0 because 0.0 is rejected by API and top_p=0.95 because that is the only value the Moonshot API accepts on this model (verified 2026-04-30 smoke test). Claude Opus 4.7 (and the rest of the Anthropic 4.X reasoning family) drops temperature and top_p entirely because the provider rejects temperature on this model family (verified 2026-04-30 smoke test). GLM 5.1 judge uses max_tokens=2048 because 1024-token canaries showed length truncation without parsable labels. GPT-5.5 decoding params (max_tokens rename to max_completion_tokens, temperature/top_p drop) are handled in the OpenAI adapter rather than here so the roster stays semantically uniform. Mistral Large 3 (2512) uses default decoding; no override needed.
